tasks.label: Build PRKMultitool (MinGW)
tasks.command: x86_64-w64-mingw32-windres resource.rc -o resource.o && x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc launcher.c GUI.c logic.c ini_manager.c game_launcher.c image_manager.c resource.o -o PRKMultitool.exe -mwindows -luser32 -lkernel32 -lcomdlg32 -lgdi32 -lgdiplus -lole32 && x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc settings.c GUI.c ini_manager.c logic.c resource.o -o settings.exe -mwindows -luser32 -lkernel32 -lcomdlg32 && x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc accounts.c GUI.c ini_manager.c logic.c resource.o -o accounts.exe -mwindows -luser32 -lkernel32
